title: Ghostling: A Minimal Terminal Embedding Engine

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Packaging terminal interfaces as native desktop apps is usually a nightmare. But the team behind the Ghosty terminal just dropped Ghostling and I'm genuinely impressed. It basically rips out Ghosty's ultra fast core engine so you can embed a real command line into anything. The whole demo is just one C file using Ray for graphics. Developers are already using it to bypass Electron entirely. It's wild.
